description: Enforce unique non-null Aplos transaction IDs in the Virtuous gift-processing ledger

file_format.checksum_input: Exact SQL file bytes, including comments and whitespace

postgresql_baseline.scope: Disposable development/test baseline; deployed version must be independently verified

prerequisites: Independently attested target and dedicated migration credentials
Verified public schema, ownership, search_path, and default privileges
Existing public.virtuous_gift_processing table with aplos_transaction_id bigint nullable
Read-only duplicate preflight and approved writer maintenance barrier
No conflicting expected index; do not infer schema from names alone
Approved executor, durable version/checksum tracking, and bounded migration lock

transaction_mode.on_error: Rollback the entire migration; resolve data conflicts only with separate authorization

excluded: Runtime schema changes or automatic migration execution
